Pakistan.instagram:
World Atlas No. 01: Kiera Brunton opened the atlas and landed on Pakistan.

Is there Latin & Ballroom in Pakistan? Barely. But the country never stopped dancing. Swipe through.

💃 Karachi banker Hazan D, co-founder of the ActOne dance centre, told Newsline he was the first Pakistani invited to the World Salsa Congress, and had taught over 4,000 people.
💃 At Chilam Joshi, the Kalash spring festival in Chitral, young men and women dance together. Couples who have chosen each other announce it to the community on the last day.
✨ Lewa, a dance of African origin, is performed by Pakistan's Sheedi community and on the Makran Coast. For the Sheedis, it is a sign of their African lineage.

PapuaNewGuinea.instagram:
World Atlas No. 02: Michael Shelton opened the atlas and landed on Papua New Guinea.

Is there Latin & Ballroom in Papua New Guinea? Not really. But wait until you see how they dance instead. Swipe through.

💃 In October 2025, Port Moresby hosted the PNG National Dance Championships, backed by the Australian High Commission. They closed with Wan Squad dancing alongside Australian crew Bloodline.
🎉 Since 2003, Milne Bay's National Kenu and Kundu Festival in Alotau has paired canoe races with drumming and dance. Its tagline: "When we hear the sound of the Kundu, we hear our ancestors."
✨ In February 2022, a PNG National Dance Troupe performed at Expo 2020 Dubai for PNG's National Day. Half its members were Creative Arts and Dance students from the University of PNG.

Mexico.instagram:
World Atlas No. 03: Jaime Dieguez opened the atlas and landed on Mexico.

Is there Latin & Ballroom in Mexico? The answer is… sort of. And the story is better for it. Swipe through.

💃 In 2023 Mexico City declared its sonidero culture intangible heritage. Months earlier, 30+ sonideros had spun cumbia and salsa for 12 hours to over 100,000 dancers in the Zócalo.
🎉 At Oaxaca’s Guelaguetza, dancers from the state’s eight regions perform on two July Mondays, the Lunes del Cerro. After each dance, communities offer crafts and fruit to the audience.
🎭 Michoacán’s Danza de los Viejitos has Purépecha roots. Dancers in pink-cheeked old-man masks shuffle stooped and slow, then burst into strong stomping.

Are you a dancer from Mexico, or do you dance there? Tell us what we missed in the comments, and tag a dancer from Mexico who should see this.

Namibia.instagram:

Is there Latin & Ballroom in Namibia? The answer is… sort of. And the story is better for it. Swipe through.

🕺 In November 2025, more than 100 dancers met in Windhoek for DanceSport Namibia’s nationals in Latin, Stage and Hip-Hop, judged by a South African panel. A national team was selected.
🎉 Oshituthi shomagongo, the marula fruit festival of eight Aawambo communities, joined UNESCO’s list in 2015. Guests share omagongo marula drink, then sing and dance.

Laos.instagram:
World Atlas No. 06: Anthony Rutherford opened the atlas and landed on Laos.

Is there Latin & Ballroom in Laos? Barely. But the country never stopped dancing. Swipe through.

💃 Want to dance salsa in Laos? The Blues Box in Vientiane runs free Thursday salsa nights, from 8:30 pm to 1 am.
🎉 Khaen music, played on a bamboo mouth organ, joined the UNESCO list in 2017. At village festivals, listeners often join in the songs and dances.
🕺 Lyon-raised Lao dancer Olé Khamchanla discovered hip-hop in 1990. In 2010 he founded the Fang Mae Khong International Dance Festival in Laos.

💃 Byina Rwanda was first announced in January 2024. That plan listed Latin ballroom styles and cha-cha, and promised the overall winner a furnished dance studio, rent-free for a year.

🕺 In September 2026, Bobo Elvis became the first dancer to represent Rwanda at the Fusion Concept freestyle world finals in Paris, reaching the round of 16.

Malawi.instagram:
World Atlas No. 08: Ian Waite opened the atlas and landed on Malawi.

Is there Latin & Ballroom in Malawi? Not really. But wait until you see how they dance instead. Swipe through.

💃 One account traces the couple dance m'bwiza to Malawians who had gone to South Africa. Its band pairs the accordion with a gong and an orchestra side drum.
🥁 Mwinoghe means "Let us enjoy ourselves". Men and women line up in two rows, twisting to three drums, a whistle and the leader's commands, with no singing.
✨ In 2019, the Lilongwe Dance Program staged Malawi's first production of The Nutcracker, to sold-out audiences.

Japan.instagram:
World Atlas No. 09: Oskar Odiakosa opened the atlas and landed on Japan.

Is there Latin & Ballroom in Japan? Spoiler: yes, and it goes back further than you think. Swipe through.

✨ The Rokumeikan opened on 28 November 1883 with a gala for about 1,200 guests. Foreign residents of Tokyo were hired to teach the dances.
💃 Today’s Japan Ballroom Dance Federation grew out of the Nippon League of Competitive Ballroom Dancing, which led Japanese ballroom for 50 years.
💃 Ballroom even has its own manga: Welcome to the Ballroom by Tomo Takeuchi, running since 2011 and turned into an anime by Production I.G in 2017.

Are you a dancer from Japan, or do you dance there? Tell us what we missed in the comments, and tag a dancer from Japan who should see this.

SaoTome.instagram:
World Atlas No. 11: Peter Maxwell opened the atlas and landed on São Tomé and Príncipe.

Is there Latin & Ballroom in São Tomé and Príncipe? The answer is… sort of. And the story is better for it. Swipe through.

🥁 Ússua took shape in the early 1900s under European influence, its bands mixing accordions with drums. Men dance it in straw hats, with an embroidered towel over the arm.
🎬 Calema's 6 June 2026 stadium show in Braga was set to screen live in 26 NOS cinemas across Portugal, from the mainland to Madeira and the Azores.
🥁 Researching the islands' music, anthropologist Magdalena Bialoborska Chambel found the national radio's archive: about 2,000 tapes from the 1960s to 1990s, once thought destroyed.
